text:
sarah_marketing: Heads-up: Zephyr micro-case (short web vignette + demo slide). Need to finalize interview slot, 1-2 publishable soundbites, legal signoff on quote release, and routing for inbound leads.

rachel_prod: I can host the interview Mon 10am PT. Prefer ~20m recorded call + 10m follow-up for clarifications.

luis_content: For the vignette copy thinking: 1) micro-headline, 2) 2 bullets (impact + time-to-value), 3) customer quote <=120 chars, then CTA. I'll draft two tone variations (technical vs. outcome).

ben_legal: Quick note: any mention of competitive comparisons or exact percentages needs a brief factual attestation from Zephyr. I'll prepare a one-click release snippet they can reply to. Example line: `I confirm this quote is factually accurate and grant Redwood permission to use it in marketing materials.`

elena_cs: Jordan at Zephyr prefers Tue or Wed afternoons. They want to review transcript and select the final quote. Also requests that we not publish any internal bench numbers unless their data team signs off.

mark_sales: Routing ask: tag inbound leads as `zephyr-microcase` and route to sales+acctdev. Sales ops wants auto-task created with 48h SLA.

opsbot: @channel Automation queued: form -> sales+acctdev@ -> SF task (create within 2 business days) tag=`zephyr-microcase`. Test trigger sent to mark_sales.

sarah_marketing: Actions: 1) Rachel lock Tue 2pm PT if Jordan confirms. 2) Luis ship two copy options and 3 suggested Qs. 3) Ben provide release snippet + short checkbox copy. 4) Elena confirm transcript review timeline. 5) Opsbot confirm routing.

rachel_prod: Locked Tue 2pm PT with Jordan. Calendar invite sent (recording enabled).

luis_content: Dropped copy variants in the doc: https://rwd.docs/zephyr-microcase v1. Two teaser lines: (A) "Zephyr accelerated inference ops, saving dev time and cost" (B) "How Zephyr cut tail-latency and boosted throughput". Also added three Qs.

ben_legal: Snippet posted in doc under /release-snippets. Suggest email language: "If you reply with APPROVE and the attached checkbox checked, we will publish the selected quote." Can also provide a PDF signoff if they prefer.

elena_cs: Jordan OK with Tue 2pm. Wants to pick quote within 48h after transcript. They requested that any benchmark claim link to our appendix or be marked "customer-reported".

mark_sales: Confirmed - opsbot automation worked. Also request a one-slide takeaway (1-2 bullets + CTA) for demo decks. Luis, can you produce that?

luis_content: Yep, will make a single-slide takeaway and add to the asset pack.

sarah_marketing: Publishing plan: teaser social post + blog microcase on launch day, webinar invite for a deeper product Q&A within 2 weeks. We'll A/B the teaser copy and measure CTR.

ben_legal: One more: include a short legal footnote under the quote: "Quote approved by customer on MM/DD/YYYY." I'll add template.

opsbot: @channel Reminder automation: once publish form is submitted, route leads -> sales+acctdev@, add tag `zephyr-microcase`, create SF task due in 48h.

elena_cs: After interview we'll send transcript within 6 hours. Jordan reiterated they pick quote and must check the release box.

sarah_marketing: Perfect. I'll post back with final copy after transcript. Thanks all :raised_hands:
